extracted.name: Popcorn Seasoning
extracted.description: The garlic and celery salts in this tasty popcorn seasoning mix (plus paprika, curry powder, and cumin) add a slightly smoky flavor to your popcorn.
instruction_lines: Mix brewer’s yeast, garlic salt, celery salt, paprika, cumin, curry powder, and cayenne pepper together in a small bowl. Store in an airtight container.
